Name: CaspersBoxSelect
Author: Casperq2
Description:
[size=6][b]Casper's Box Select[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]

click-and-drag box selection tool for Stardew Valley. Select any rectangular area and instantly demolish, collect, or till and water it.

[line]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[b]Box Selection System[/b]
Hold Ctrl and drag with your mouse to select any rectangular area. A colored preview box shows exactly what you're selecting.

[b]Three Modes[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Ctrl + Left Click (Red)[/b] - Demolish: Destroys trees, stumps, rocks, boulders, weeds, twigs, grass, and crops
[*][b]Ctrl + Right Click (Green)[/b] - Collect: Harvests ready crops, picks up forage, and collects dropped items
[*][b]Ctrl + Middle Click (Blue)[/b] - Till and Water: Tills soil and waters all tilled dirt in the selection
[/list]

[b]Box Select Scythe[/b]
A special scythe is added to your inventory that enables the box selection feature. The scythe works normally when not holding Ctrl.

[line]

[size=4][b]How To Use[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Equip the Box Select Scythe from your inventory
[*]Hold Ctrl and drag with your mouse to create a selection box
[*]Release to execute the action based on which mouse button you used
[/list]

[line]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

Edit config.json or use Generic Mod Config Menu:

[list]
[*][b]EnableDetailedLogging[/b] (default: false) - Show debug info in SMAPI console
[/list]

[line]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI (latest version)
[*]Download this mod and unzip into Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]Run the game
[/list]

[line]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]SMAPI 4.0+
[*]Single-player and multiplayer (host must have mod installed)
[/list]

[line]

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]

Created by Casper
